sentences.text:
1 . Judgment and order dated 30.09.2008 rendered by learned Judicial Magistrate First  C l a s s , G o n d a l i n C r i m i n a l C a s e N o . 2 3 3 o f  2003 recording acquittal for the offence punishable under sections 2(1 a)(a)(m), section 7(1)(5) and 16(1)(a)(i) of the Prevention of Food R/CR.A/518/2009 JUDGMENT Adulteration Act, 1954 ( for short 'PFA Act') has been assailed in this  appeal under section 378 of the Code of Criminal Procedure ( for short 'Cr.P.C.).
2 . O n c o n s i d e r a t i o n o f t h e r i v a l c o n t e n t i o n s , i t i s f o u n d t h a t t h e o r d e r  o f a c q u i t t a l i s r e q u i r e d t o b e u p h e l d o n o n e o f t h e g r o u n d s u r g e d b e f o r e  t h i s c o u r t b e i n g b r e a c h o f s e c t i o n 1 3 ( 2 A ) o f t h e P F A A c t . C o n c e d e d l y  the sample of soft drink beverages collected was best for use before October 2002 and sanction

sentences.text: for the prosecution of the opponent
was given on 16.01.2003 and the complaint came  to be lodged on 05.02.2003 i.e. after expiry of the best before date.

Section 13(2A) of the PFA  A c t p r e s c r i b e s a v a l u a b l e r i g h t t o t h e a c c u s e d t o g e t t h e  s a m p l e o f t h e a r t i c l e c o l l e c t e d b y t h e F o o d I n s p e c t o r , t o b e t e s t e d b y
C e n t r a l F o o d L a b o r a t o r y . T h e p r o d u c e r o f t h e c o n s u m a b l e f o o d a r t i c l e

may fix the expiry date keeping in view various aspects including the possibility of the article  g e t t i n g c o n t a m i n a t e d o w i n g t o n a t u r a l h e a l t h  hazards or decaying of the article of food by passage of time.

Expiry date on the food article  i t s e l f i s a n a d m i s s i o n t h a t i t i s n o t g o o d f o r  consumption beyond the said date and therefore, at that stage if the sample is sent at the  i n s t a n c e o f t h e a c c u s e d t o t h e c e n t r a l f o o d  l a b o r a t o r y , t h e c h a n c e s o f t h e r e p o r t o f t h e c e n t r a l f o o d l a b o r a t o r y b e  a d v e r s e t o h i m w o u l d b e o n t h e h i g h e r s i d e a n d t h e r e f o r e , n o a c c u s e d  w o u l d v e n t u r e t o t a k e a c h a n c e a n d i n f a c t a f t e r e x p i r y d a t e , h e h a s n o

o p p o r t u n i t y a s c o n t e m p l a t e d u n d e r s e c t i o n 1 3 ( 2 A ) o f t h e P F A A c t t h e  valuable right of the accused would be frustrated and lost under such circumstances. 
3. Barring special case provided by the rules, a sample of food  article collected under Section 11(1) is required to be divided into three R/CR.A/518/2009 JUDGMENT parts, one of which is required to be sent to the public analyst and then other two  parts would be retained by local health authority for the purposes of sub s e c t i o n ( 2 ) o f S e c t i o n 1 1 , s u b s e c t i o n s ( 2 A ) a n d ( 2 E ) o f  S e c t i o n 1 3 .

S u b s e c t i o n ( 2 ) a n d ( 2 A ) o f S e c t i o n 1 3 c o n f e r s u p o n a n  a c c u s e d a v a l u a b l e r i g h t t o a p p l y w i t h i n t e n d a y s f r o m t h e r e c e i p t o f t h e  r e p o r t o f t h e p u b l i c a n a l y s t t o t h e C o u r t f o r d i s p a t c h o f o n e o f t h e p a r t s  of the sample to the Central Food Laboratory for analysis.

The order passed by the court under sub section (2A) is required to be complied with within a specified period of five days from the  receipt of the requisition of the Court, by the local health authority.
Thus an element of  urgency or promptness can be noticed in subsection (2) and (2A) of Section 13.
The element of  p r o m p t n e s s c o n t e m p l a t e d i n t h e s a i d  provision is not without any object.

It must be borne in mind that article sought to be dealt with  u n d e r t h e A c t i s f o o d a r t i c l e w h i c h m a y b e  State Of Gujarat, Thro' Nitinkumar ... vs Pratik Jagdishbhai Khakkhar Vendor on 20 June, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/123896018/
2 subject to natural decay or other hazards by passage of time.

The law obligates the manufacturers  t o d e f i n e t h e l i f e o f f o o d a r t i c l e s o n i t s  p a c k a g e s t o e n s u r e t h a t c o n t a m i n a t e d a n d d e c a y e d f o o d a r t i c l e s w h i c h  m i g h t h a v e o u t l i v e d i t s u t i l i t y a n d m a y h a v e b e c o m e h e a l t h h a z a r d d o  n o t l a n d i n t h e h a n d s o f t h e c o n s u m e r s .
S p e c i f i c a t i o n o f l i f e o f a f o o d  article would necessarily imply that it would no longer be good for use beyond the specific date.

T h e c h a n c e s o f f o o d a r t i c l e d e c a y i n g o r  g e t t i n g c o n t a m i n a t e d a f t e r s p e c i f i c d a t e o f i t s l i f e w o u l d b e o n t h e h i g h e r  s i d e .

T h e f o o d a r t i c l e c o m p l y i n g w i t h t h e m i n i m u m s t a n d a r d s b e f o r e t h e  e x p i r y o f i t s l i f e m a y f a i l t o c o m p l y w i t h t h e m i n i m u m s t a n d a r d s o r w i t h  o t h e r r e q u i r e m e n t s u n d e r t h e P . F . A . A c t f o r t h e f o r e g o i n g r e a s o n s , a f t e r
the expiry of its life if put to scientific test.

It is for this reason that whole exercise contemplated  u n d e r t h e A c t i n c l u d i n g o n e u n d e r s e c t i o n s  1 3 ( 2 ) a n d 1 3 ( 2 A ) a n d ( 2 E ) m u s t b e c o m p l e t e d b e f o r e t h e e x p i r y o f l i f e o f  food article.

The purpose of the said provision, particularly subsection R/CR.A/518/2009 JUDGMENT (2A) of Section 13 would be served only if the food article has life in it  u n t i l t h e d a t e o f i t s a n a l y s i s b y c e n t r a l f o o d l a b o r a t o r y .
T h e r i g h t o f t h e  a c c u s e d u n d e r s e c t i o n 1 3 ( 2 ) a n d 1 3 ( 2 A ) i s a c r u c i a l r i g h t c a p a b l e o f

fetching a possible benefit for the accused to get the adverse public analyst report superseded  i n t e r m s o f s u b s e c t i o n 3 o f s e c t i o n 1 3 . I t  w o u l d n o t m a k e s e n s e f o r t h e a c c u s e d t o g e t t h e s a m p l e o r f o o d a r t i c l e  w h i c h h a s l o s t i t s l i f e , e x a m i n e d s c i e n t i f i c a l l y .

H i s r i g h t w o u l d t h u s g e t  f r u s t r a t e d i n a b s e n c e o f s c i e n t i f i c e x a m i n a t i o n o f t h e f o o d a r t i c l e w i t h i n  the specified life of the food article concerned.
4 . I n a b o v e v i e w o f t h e m a t t e r n o i n t e r f e r e n c e i s c a l l e d f o r i n t h e
acquittal appeal.
Accordingly appeal fails and is dismissed.
5. Record and Proceedings, if any shall be returned to the Court below.
